name: Szary dom / The Grey House
description: Karolina Lanckorońska's villa, later used as camp prison and torture site.

name: Biuro zarządu obozu / Camp Administration
description: Main administrative office managing inmate registries and labor allocation.

name: Komendatura / Camp Headquarters
description: Ameth Goeth's official command villa overlooking the lower execution grounds.

name: Barak dla mężczyzn / Men's Barracks (M1)
description: Standard wooden living quarters for male forced laborers.

name: Barak עבור קבוצת Balba / Clothing Warehouse
description: Storage unit for confiscated civilian personal belongings and clothing processing.

name: Wielka żydowska nekropolia / Jewish Cemetery
description: The historic ruined pre-war cemetery destroyed during camp expansion.
